interaction.drag: continuous on XZ plane with independently controllable Y height
interaction.update: model position and dependent visualization update during pointer movement

rules: speaker count is unrestricted by architecture
speaker height is user-adjustable inside the room volume
speaker orientation affects directional acoustic calculations when the selected SpeakerModel provides directivity data
manufacturer/model acoustic data belongs to SpeakerModel rather than being duplicated into every Speaker instance
a Speaker instance may exist without a library-backed model and then uses explicitly supplied fallback behavior
